arguments.content: Protocol evolution review pattern: upgrading a success-response test double alongside a new unconditional receipt check can hide a regression against an independently shipped provider. Validate an ordinary/default-feature save end to end against the supported release, checking both persisted state and caller-visible success: a provider may apply the write and return its legacy acknowledgement, after which the client reports failure solely because the new receipt field is absent. Keep legacy success coverage until receipt capability is enabled or negotiated. Observed in enhanced-settings task 1: the released eval-release provider applies settings and returns {"ok": true}; the new unconditional applied-is-True check raises even with enhanced_settings=false, while the updated receipt-bearing unit-test stub passes.
